title: SQL injection in /api/search
description: The q parameter is concatenated into a query. Observed with password=hunter2 in the debug echo.
impact:
Database read access.
```sql
SELECT * FROM users; -- PAYLOAD-MARKER impact block
```
technical_analysis: Unsanitised input reaches the ORM raw() call.
poc_description: Send a single quote in q and observe the SQL error.
remediation_steps:
Use parameterised queries.
```python
cur.execute('SELECT 1 WHERE x=%s', (q,))
```

code_locations.snippet: rows = db.raw("SELECT * FROM items WHERE name = '" + q + "'")
code_locations.label: sink

title: Broken object level authorization on /api/orders/{id}
description: Orders of other tenants are readable by id.
technical_analysis: No ownership check on the order lookup.
